markdown:
# Actions reference



Actions are now covered in [Project scripts](/docs/reference/scripts#run-scripts).

Use an action when the Run button should start your app, server, test watcher, worker, or another long-running command from the active workspace. Open [`Settings`](https://app.conductor.build/settings/repos?section=actions), select the project, and edit Custom actions on the Actions tab, or use `.conductor/settings.local.toml` for local file-backed changes.

For projects that cannot run cleanly from a workspace directory, see [Spotlight testing](/docs/reference/scripts/spotlight-testing).
